title: My Worth is Not in What I Own
lyrics_original: My worth is not in what I own,
Not in the strength of flesh and bone,
But in the costly wounds of love
At the cross.
My worth is not in skill or name,
In win or lose, in pride or shame,
But in the blood of Christ that flowed
At the cross.
I rejoice in my Redeemer
Greatest Treasure,
Wellspring of my soul!
I will trust in Him, no other.
My soul is satisfied in Him alone.
As summer flowers we fade and die,
Fame, youth and beauty hurry by,
But life eternal calls to us
At the cross.
I will not boast in wealth or might,
Or human wisdom's fleeting light,
But I will boast in knowing Christ
At the cross.
I rejoice in my Redeemer
Greatest Treasure,
Wellspring of my soul!
I will trust in Him, no other.
My soul is satisfied in Him alone.
Two wonders here that I confess,
My worth and my unworthiness.
My value fixed - my ransom paid,
At the cross.
I rejoice in my Redeemer
Greatest Treasure,
Wellspring of my soul
I will trust in Him, no other.
My soul is satisfied in Him alone.
I rejoice in my Redeemer
Greatest Treasure,
Wellspring of my soul!
I will trust in Him, no other.
My soul is satisfied in Him alone.

author_english: By Keith & Kristyn Getty, and Graham Kendrick

bible_verses.english: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
For you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s.

However, I consider these things that were advantages to me as a loss for Christ. Yes, most certainly, I count all things to be loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them as refuse, that I may gain Christ

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for defining my worth not by my accomplishments, but by Your sacrifice on the cross. Forgive me for the times I seek validation in earthly things, status, or performance. Fix my heart on the costly love You poured out for me, and teach me to rejoice in You as my greatest treasure. In Your precious name, Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: We live in a world that constantly measures our value by what we accomplish, possess, or perform. Yet, this song gently reminds us that our true identity was settled at the cross. Your worth is never tied to your earthly status, successes, or failures, but to the infinite price Jesus paid for you. Today, release the pressure to prove yourself and rest in the glorious truth that Christ is your ultimate treasure.
